page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is a high-frequency compute instance built on KVM virtualization technology. Powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 3.1 GHz, it provides 64 dedicated vCPUs alongside 256 GB of system RAM, maintaining a balanced 1:4 CPU-to-memory allocation ratio (4 GB per vCPU). The instance contains no local NVMe or ephemeral storage disks, requiring external network-attached block storage for all operating system and application data.

Networking features on the ecs.hfg6.16xlarge include a baseline bandwidth capacity of 20 Gbps. The lack of integrated local storage represents a key design tradeoff, shifting disk IOPS and latency dependencies to external network volumes while maintaining high network throughput. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high base clock speed combined with high physical core density enables high core throughput, reducing the node count required for parallel computing tasks.

Given its 3.1 GHz CPU clock rate, 64 dedicated vCPUs, and 256 GB RAM allocation, the instance is well suited for enterprise application servers, continuous integration build infrastructure, electronic design automation (EDA), and distributed data processing applications.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is a high-frequency virtual machine powered by KVM hypervisor technology. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs utilizing x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processors operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz, paired with 256 GB of RAM, yielding 4.0 GB of memory per core. The server does not include bundled local disk storage, depending entirely on network-attached block storage, but provides a high baseline network throughput of 20 Gbps. With its high processor clock frequency and balanced memory ratio, the instance offers strong compute efficiency for multi-threaded and single-threaded workloads without accelerator hardware. It is structured for demanding compute tasks, including continuous integration build systems, electronic design automation, enterprise application servers, and data processing jobs.
